paragraphs.text:
It’s no use; your fear has gotten the better of you. You are not 
thinking about Bernard when, with a faint whimper, you slide 
down  the  rise,  your  eyes  burning  with  tears,  hoping  against 
hope that the thing on the other side will let you get away.
Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 171; if failed, go to 172.
